schema_family: claude-root-worker-seam-design (v1 and v2 key sets retained; v3 adds capi_predecessor, totality, runtime_checks and new_author_observations)
author: Claude Code lead claude-opus-5-5 (drafting subagent, author role)

acceptance.review: An independent actual gpt-6.1-sol review of v3 is required. The author grants nothing; author checks are self-checks.

statement_basis: Static. Every statement about source was read from files or reasoned from what was read. Nothing was compiled, run, imported, proved, tested or measured. Kernel, systemd, interpreter and Ada-visibility statements marked [unverified reasoning] name their evidence item.

design_document.relation: v3 is this file plus the carried v2 slices of self_containment with replacements R3-1 ... R3-43 applied, plus, transitively, the v1 slices bound by slice C2-APC.

companions.hash_cycle: SEAM-DESIGN.md Appendix D binds jackal.json and AUTHOR-NOTES.md. This file binds all three. This file's own identity is reported in the handback.

answers_review.partially_closed: every other required change and ruling, and RQ-1

v5.used_as: labelled dependencies only: R-QUAL, branch-sensitive R-GATE, MQ1-MQ14 ([depends on unreviewed CAPI5])

self_containment.rule: Each carried slice is the UTF-8 bytes of the stated v2 lines, each followed by a newline, bound by sha256. Replacements quote the exact v2 lines. Every other v2 text is replaced (SEAM-DESIGN.md §B.3).
self_containment.verification: Read-only script: every carried slice hash, every quoted replacement (exact, and inside its stated slice), no overlapping slices, and every transitive v1 slice matched (SEAM-DESIGN.md Appendix C).

totality.statement: v2's total Rebase and Emb are withdrawn (TOTAL-EMBEDDING). Emb is defined on D_emb only. The residuals R1, R2 and R3 are coverage limits that the unchanged original unit decides. CV-B' and CV-R are stated obligations, not proved.

rq1.note: Current context only in native Reserve, Record_Launch_Intent and Record_Running; RETAINED join for every canonical caller; positive rollover controls listed.

ruling.D-2b: C2-116; owner and evidence carried verbatim in SEAM-DESIGN.md §A.5

clauses.04.2: C2-62 (R3-10 and R3-11 keep the exclusive branches)

new_author_observations.NF-1: O_RDONLY host procfs dirfd is a writable view for an euid-0 holder [unverified, K-18]
new_author_observations.NF-2: Root-head, PRIME, catalogue or physical-head rollovers do not block launch-side commands
new_author_observations.NF-3: status is mutating and takes both asyncio locks
new_author_observations.NF-4: Original startup recovery settles a retained RESULT_CAPTURE with no terminal prerequisite
new_author_observations.NF-5: CAPI5 section 19 still calls the draft renamings body-level (unreviewed document)
new_author_observations.NF-6: The V3 slot calls systemctl directly; systemd control reachable from an euid-0 coordinator [unverified, K-17]
new_author_observations.NF-7: The router awaits every collector under its lock; the front refuses unless FRONT_OWNED
new_author_observations.NF-8: Two canonical JSON forms: UTF-8 (exact_json) and ASCII (exact)
new_author_observations.NF-9: client_peer_relay rebuilds RequestPeer by whole re-read equality; byte-identical to S5; used only by a test
new_author_observations.NF-10: The owner plan arrives as an argument; the v1 descriptor has no root-worker key
new_author_observations.NF-11: The custody genesis carries no MAC; events and head do

process.writes: Only Write and Edit, only in WT/designs/claude-root-worker-seam-design-v3/. Files: SEAM-DESIGN.md, jackal.json, AUTHOR-NOTES.md, seams.json. Final counts are in the handback.
process.write_refusals: none; two Edit calls failed with 'String to replace not found' (own input spanning non-adjacent rows) and were redone as single-row Edits
process.bash: read-only inspection only; no redirection to any file; 2>&1 only into pipes; no 2>/dev/null; deviations listed in AUTHOR-NOTES.md section 5.2
harness_persisted_outputs: one oversized command output persisted by the harness to the session's tool-results directory and read with Read
process.not_run: No WORLDLINE, COSMOGONY or root-worker code imported or executed; no compilers, provers, tests, services, systemctl, sudo, namespaces, project-vault or restic; nothing under /srv

sia.truth_boundary: boundary: senses live · chains pass · graph complete · 6 span(s) redacted at ingest · semantic recall · associative rerank off by measured default; retrieval.associative_rerank enables it · absence of recall ≠ evidence of absence

process.skills: ada, ada-omarchy, spark-users-guide, ada-programming, advanced-ada, gnat-toolchain, ada-2005-amendment, ada-high-integrity, worldline, cosmogony (loaded at session start, applied)

non_claims: This design reviews, accepts, qualifies, proves and authorizes nothing. Every original Phase One obligation and every lane seam remains OPEN.
Nothing was compiled, run, imported, proved, tested or measured.
Hash and inventory agreement establishes only byte identity.
[unverified reasoning] and [depends on unreviewed CAPI5] statements need the named evidence or review.
No reserved-capacity, completion, confinement or deadlock-freedom property is claimed.
SIA recall is model-origin recall, not evidence.
Author checks are self-checks and do not substitute for the required independent review.
Nothing changes any original target, accepted case, deterministic fixture, control, contract, threshold, proof floor or scope.
